english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is too painful or unpleasant to put up with.
Choose this when the annoyance feels unbearable or you want to stress that you cannot put up with it.

examples.english: The heat lately is unbearable for me.
examples.traditional: 呢排咁熱，我真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 gam3 jit6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

examples.english: The air conditioner has been broken for a whole week; I'm really fed up with this heat.
